mapping.core: One native burst particle, source grayscale sampled in ported URP shader. Native Custom1.x clock; SAME source flow/stretch/warp/mask/erosion/ramp. No baked flame texture.
mapping.sparks: Native continuous Emission, Box birth domain, decaying velocity curves, Noise, lifetime cooling/fade, Stretched Billboard using the original static X-oriented streak.
mapping.embers: Same one static streak, rectangular Billboard, slow velocity and noise, cooling and size variation.
mapping.smoke: Original one static puff, continuous native Emission, Box, upward velocity/force, Noise, random rotation, separate-axis growth, gray color/alpha envelope.
mapping.glow: Three additive native static particles. No Light component.
mapping.prop: Two ordinary static SpriteRenderers; mouth anchor (512,855).

differences: Native random births and Noise approximate analytic seeded particle identities, sinusoidal wander, and trajectories.
Random lifetime velocity curves use reference lifetimes; not every source exponential path is identical.
Streak hot head is approximated by native color/brightness; not a second scheduled particle.
Linear-space Unity alpha/additive composition can differ slightly from browser Canvas.
Changing core material Flow also requires matching Core Main duration/lifetime to 8/Flow for seamless native clock restart.

import.noise: Linear data, Mirror, Bilinear, no mipmaps, uncompressed
import.stamps: Static RGBA, Clamp, Bilinear, no mipmaps, uncompressed
import.props: Single Sprite, PPU 128, mouth pivot x .5 / y 1-87/512
